newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end mixed, focus on Fed.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end mixed, focus on Fed.

text.p: 1750 GMT - Portuguese shares closed mixed with the indices weaker in turnover of just four billion escudos, about half the recent daily average. Activity centred on shares in troubled ship repairer Lisnave and in stocks linked to Sonae Investimentos. "Tomorrow's session should be quiet like today, with dealers reluctant to take positions ahead of the Fed's decision on rates. The market has discounted a 25 basis points hike in U.S. rates," said one operator.
